text:
Priya S: FYI our APAC webinar (yesterday evening) created a weird spike routed mostly to EMEA queues and we saw jitter in owner rotation. Some leads stayed in 'pending-enrich' for > 1h. Weekend SLO is 45m in APAC window. We missed it for ~30 leads. Thoughts?
Tom B: Confirmed. HubSpot webhook retries overlapped with SFDC connector throttling. The router backoff pushes leads back into RR and some workers dropped them.
Jules M: Could be the timezone routing rule that maps +08/+09 to eu-pool during DST change. We had an edge rule that prefers eu-pool on capacity hints; that seems wrong for APAC-heavy events.
Nina K: Quick mitigation idea: widen SLO window for apac-webinars tag to 90m for the next 12 hours and route to overflow-sdr rather than eu-pool. We can revert after traffic normalizes.
Priya S: Prefer short-lived fix that avoids reassign churn. If we widen SLO, we should also add a metric and an alert that triggers when rollover_assigns > 5 in 1h.
Tom B: Alternative: on webhook retry failures, set a lightweight "fast-assign" flag with low-confidence owner (overflow-sdr) that can be replaced by the enriched owner when available. Assigner is idempotent so swap is safe.
Jules M: I like flag approach. Suggest rules: only for tag:apac-webinar OR source:zoom, only when webhook_retries >= 3 and enrich_wait > 90s. Also add safety: max 2 swaps per lead to avoid churn.
Nina K: I'll open a config change: route fallback -> overflow-sdr, limit to 12h window, add swap_count check.
Priya S: Can we scope deploy to canary first? Also ops-bot, please post to #oncall when we flip the rule.
ops-bot: Canary deploy scheduled by Nina K at 2024-10-12T02:20:00Z for apac-webinar-fallback - watch #deploys
Tom B: For observability, I'll add these panels: time_to_first_claim (by tz), fallback_swaps, unowned_leads_by_tag. Also threshold alert: if unowned_leads_by_tag[apac-webinar] > 8 for 60m -> paged to oncall.
Jules M: I'll prepare a short simulation script to replay the webinar CSV and force webhook timeouts. Quick snippet: ```bash
# simulate 200 leads with delayed enrich
python tools/replay_leads.py --file webinar_apac.csv --delay 120
```
Priya S: Great. Nina, when you push the config, ping here with the canary url and rollback steps. Also record the incident ticket: https://jira.redwood/browse/MKT-5142.
Nina K: PR: https://git.redwood/routing-configs/pull/789 - changes: 1) add apac-webinar fallback rule, 2) set swap cap = 2, 3) timer window 12h. Canary starts in 10m.
Tom B: I'll kick off the replay against canary and monitor metrics.
ops-bot: Canary deploy completed at 2024-10-12T02:30:00Z - success.
Jules M: Replay done. Fallbacks triggered 18 times, swap_count capped at 2, no duplicate owners observed. Time to first claim median dropped from 52m -> 8m for simulated traffic.
Priya S: This looks good as temporary mitigation. Keep the rule for 24h then revert. Update the runbook and note the DST mapping bug for a proper fix. Thanks team :rocket:
